labTestFirst.question: Do I need a lab test first?
labTestFirst.answer: It isn't required, but it's the best start. Training zones from your own lactate or VO₂max test are more accurate than any estimate, and your plan is built on them.

devices.question: Which watch do I need?
devices.answer: Any watch or bike computer that can export workout files (.FIT, .TCX or .GPX), such as Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto or Wahoo. You upload your workouts; no special connection is needed.

minimumTerm.question: Is there a minimum term?
minimumTerm.answer: Coaching and Elite run for at least 3 months. Plan has no minimum term.

yearly.question: Can I pay for a year?
yearly.answer: Yes. Pay for a year up front and you get 2 months free.

messages.question: Who answers my messages?
messages.answer: Your coach. Messages are always answered by a person: within 72 hours on Plan, 48 hours on Coaching and 24 hours on Elite.

whoWrites.question: Is my plan written by Jaka?
whoWrites.answer: Your plan is built on Jaka's method and adjusts to your training every week. On Coaching, Jaka also comments on your weeks and you talk every month; on Elite, every two weeks, with sessions in person. Messages are always answered by a person.

coachingFit.question: Is coaching only for competitors?
coachingFit.answer: No. Plan and Coaching are for anyone with a goal, from a first half marathon to a season of races. Elite is for competitors.

coachingTime.question: How many hours a week do I need?
coachingTime.answer: As many as you have. Your plan is built on the days and hours you can train, and adapts when a week changes.

coachingStart.question: How do I start?
coachingStart.answer: Send your goal and race date. We reply within two working days with the package that fits and, if you haven't been tested yet, a lactate test to set your zones.

cta.title: Not sure which package fits?
cta.text: Write to me with your goal and I'll suggest where to start.
